The linear sum is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{4029}\frac{k}{2015}=\frac{4029\cdot 4030}{2\cdot 2015}=4029.
\]
The sine sum cancels by symmetry:
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{4029}\sin\left(\frac{\pi k}{2015}\right)=0.
\]
The constant sum is
\[
\sum_{k=1}^{4029}3=3\cdot 4029=12087.
\]
Thus
\[
S=4029+0-12087=-8058.
\]

\boxed{-8058}
